# Sintesis {-}

## Vectores 

| $v, u \in \reals^n$ | $\in$            |                                                                               |
| :--------          | :----------      | :-------------------                                                          |
| $vv^\top$          | $\Mnn$ (rango 1) | Operador de Proyección Ortogonal en $v$ \ $P_v=\frac{v\trans{v}}{\trans{v}v}$ |
| $v^\top v$         | $\reals$         | $\inner{v}{v} = \|v\|^2$                                                      |
| $vu^\top$          | $\Mnn$ (rango 1) | Descomposicion RC \ $\chi_A(\lambda) = (-\lambda)^{n-1} (v^\top u - \lambda)$ | 
| $v^\top u$         | $\reals$         | $\inner{v}{u} = \|v\|\|u\|\cos\theta$                                         |

## Matrices

+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
|               |                            |                                                              |
+===============+============================+==============================================================+
| Stiefel       | $Q \in \Mmn$\              | - Isometría                                                  |
|               | $\trans{Q} Q = \identity$  | - Columnas ortonormales                                      |
|               |                            | - $Q\trans{Q} = P_Q$                                         |
|               |                            | - Idempotente, Invariante en $Q$                             |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Ortogonal     | $Q \in \Mnn$               | - Caso particular de Stiefel, ademas cuadrada                |
|               |                            | - Autovectores $\in \mathbb{C}^n$ ortogonales ($v^*w=0$)     |
|               |                            | - $Q^{-1}=\trans{Q}$                                         |
|               |                            | - $\lambda_i\in\mathbb{C},\ |\lambda_i| = 1$                 |
|               |                            | - Isometria (preserva normas y angulos)                      |
|               |                            | - si $\lambda\in\reals$ entonces $\lambda=\pm1$              |
|               |                            | - Rotacion $\det(Q)=1$, o Reflexion $\det(Q)=-1$             |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Simétrica     | $S \in \MRnn$\             | - Autovectores ortogonales                                   |
|               | $S = S^\top$               | - $\lambda \in \reals$                                       |
|               |                            | - $S=Q\Lambda Q^\top$                                        |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Simétrica y   | $S \in \MRnn$\             | - $\lambda=\pm1$                                             |
| Ortogonal     | $S = S^\top$\              |                                                              |
|               | $S^{-1}=S^\top$            |                                                              |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Hermítica     | $S \in \MCnn$\             | - Autovectores ortogonales (en $\mathbb{C}$, $v^*w=0$)       |
|               | $S = S^* = \hermit{S}$     | - $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$                                   |
|               |                            | - $S=Q\Lambda \trans{Q}$                                     |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Antisimétrica | $A$\                       | - $\lambda$ imaginario puro o cero                           |
|               | $\trans{A}=-A$             |                                                              |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Householder   | $H$                        | - $H = (I-2vv^\top)u$                                        |
|               |                            | - Simetrica (proyección ortogonal)                           |
|               |                            | - Involutiva ($H^2=\identity$)                               |
|               |                            | - Ortogonal (isometría)                                      |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+

## Proyecciónes y Reflexiónes

| $u, v \in \reals^n, \norm{u} = \norm{v} = 1$ |                                    |
| :------------------                          | :--------------------------------- |
| Proyección de $u$ sobre $v$                  | $u_v = (vv^\top)u = v\inner{v}{u}$ |
| Proyección de $u$ sobre $v^\perp$            | $u_{v^\perp} = (I-vv^\top)u$       |
| Proyección de $u$ sobre $C(Q)$               | $QQ^\top u$                        |
| Reflección de $u$ sobre hiperplano $v^\perp$ | $H = (I-2vv^\top)u$                |

<br/>

| Operador de Proyección Ortogonal en $C(Q)$   | $Q\trans{Q}$                       |
| :------------------                          | :--------------------------------- |
| Idempotencia                                 | $P^2=P$                            |
| Invarianza                                   | $v=Qx \implies Pv = v$             |
| Simetrica                                    | $P=\trans{P}$                      |
| Ortogonal                                    | $(Py)^\top(x-Px)=0, \forall y$     |
| Semidefinida Positiva                        | $\succeq 0$                        |

<br/>

| Operador de Proyección Ortogonal en $C(A)$   | $P = AA^+ = A\inv{(\trans{A}A)}\trans{A}$ |
| :------------------                          | :--------------------------------- |
| Idempotente | |
| Simetrica   | |

## Factorizaciones

|                       | Hipótesis                           | Origen            |
| :----                 | :------------                       | :------           |
| $A = CR$              |                                     |                   |
| $A = X\Lambda X^{-1}$ | $A\in\Mnn$ con $n$ Autovectores l.i.| $AX=X\Lambda$     |
| $S = Q\Lambda Q^\top$ | $S=S^\top$, $S\in\Mnn$              | Teorema Espectral |
| $A = U\Sigma V^\top$  |                                     |                   |

## Normas Vectoriales

| $v \in \reals^n$ | Definicion                                                         | a.k.a.      |
| :-              | :--------                                                           | :---        |
| $\ell_0$        | $\norm{v}_0 = \#\{i: v_i \neq 0\}$                                  | No es norma |
| $\ell_1$        | $\norm{v}_1 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} |v_i| = |v_1| + |v_2| + \dots + |v_n|$ | Manhattan   |
| $\ell_2$        | $\norm{v}_2 = \sigma_1$                                             | Euclidea    |
| $\ell_p$        | $\norm{v}_p = \left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} |v_i|^p \right)^{1/p}$          |             |
| $\ell_\infty$   | $\norm{v}_\infty = \max |v_i| \ \ i=1\dots n$                       | Máximo      |
| $S$             | $\norm{v}_S = \sqrt{\trans{v}Sv}$                                   | S / Energía |

<br/>

| Propiedades    | $v, w \in \reals^n$                                                          |
| :--            | :----------                                                                 |
| Positividad    | $\norm{v}>=0, \quad \norm{v} = 0 \implies v=0$                              |
| Homogeneidad   | $\norm{cv} = |c| \cdot \norm{v}$                                            |
| Triángular     | $\norm{v+w} \le \norm{v} + \norm{w}$                                        |
| Polarizacion   | $\inner{v}{w} = \frac{1}{4} \left( \norm{v + w}^2 - \norm{v - w}^2 \right)$ |
| Paralelogramo  | $\norm{v+w}^2 + \norm{v-w}^2 = 2\norm{v}^2 + 2\norm{w}^2$                   |
| Cauchy-Schwarz | $|\trans{v}w| \leq \norm{v}_2\norm{w}_2$                                    |


## Producto interno Hilbert-Schmidt

$$\inner{A}{B}_{HS} = \text{tr}(\trans{A}B) = \sum_{j=1}^n\sum_{i=1}^ma_{ij}b_{ij}=vec(A) \cdot vec(B)$$

| Propiedades     |                                   |
| :---            | :--------                         |
| Simetría        | $\inner{A}{B}=\inner{B}{A}$       |
| Linealidad      | $\inner{cA}{B}=c\inner{A}{B}$     |
| Positividad     | $\inner{A}{A} \geq 0, \ A \neq 0$ |


## Normas Matriciales

| a.k.a                | Definicion                                                                                            | Expresión Espectral                                 | Inducida por        |
| :----                | :--------------                                                                                       | :--------                                           | :-------            |
| Operador / Espectral | $\displaystyle \norm{A}_2 = \max_{x\neq0}{\frac{\norm{Ax}}{\norm{x}}} = \max_{\norm{x}=1}{\norm{Ax}}$ | $\displaystyle \sigma_1$                            | Norma $\ell_2$      |
|                      | $\displaystyle \norm{A}_1=\max_{1 \leq j \leq n}{ \sum_{i=1}^m{ |a_{ij}| } }$                         |                                                     | Norma $\ell_1$      |
|                      | $\displaystyle \norm{A}_\infty=\max_{1 \leq i \leq m}{ \sum_{j=1}^n{ |a_{ij}| } }$                    |                                                     | Norma $\ell_\infty$ |
| Nuclear / Traza      | $\displaystyle \norm{A}_N = \sigma_1 + \dots + \sigma_r$                                              | $\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^r{\sigma_i}$              |                     |
| Frobenius            | $\displaystyle \norm{A}_F = \left( \sum_{i=1}^m \sum_{j=1}^n |a_{ij}|^2 \right)^{\half}$              | $\displaystyle \left(\sum{\sigma_i^2}\right)^\half$ | Hilbert-Schmidt     |

<br/>

| Propiedades                                |                                                     |
| :----                                      | :----                                               |
| $\norm{A}_2 = \sigma_1$                    |                                                     |
| $\norm{A}_F = (\sigma_1^2 + \dots + \sigma_r^2)^\half = \sqrt{\inner{A}{A}_{HS}} = \sqrt{\traza{\trans{A}A}}$ | |
| $\norm{A}_N = \sum_{i=1\dots r}{\sigma_i}$ |                                                     |
| $\norm{AB}\leq\norm{A}\norm{B}$            |                                                     |
| $\norm{QA}=\norm{AQ}=\norm{A}$             | Invarianza Ortogonal (Frobenius, Operador, Nuclear) |
| $\norm{A}_2\leq\norm{A}_F\leq\norm{A}_N$   |                                                     |

## SVD

$$A = U\Sigma\trans{V}$$
$$A^+ = (\trans{A} A)^{-1} \trans{A}$$
